title: Designing Biomedical Artificial Intelligence Experiments
audience: Basic science learners designing AI experiments for cellular imaging and phenotype discovery
objectives: Identify literature gaps and convert them into SMART research questions.
Design a data management strategy for cellular imaging experiments.
Choose candidate AI models, evaluation metrics, and validation strategies.
Reflect on ethics, limitations, reproducibility, and multidisciplinary communication.

sections.name: Knowledge Gaps and Research Questions
sections.purpose: Help learners define why the experiment is needed.
sections.how_to_use: Select at least three gaps, then write one primary and two secondary SMART research questions.

sections.name: Data Management Strategy
sections.purpose: Plan how image data will be selected, cleaned, processed, and split.
sections.how_to_use: Choose staining channels, quality criteria, preprocessing methods, feature extraction, dimensionality reduction, and split strategy.

sections.name: Experimental Design
sections.purpose: Choose AI methods and evaluation criteria for classification or discovery.
sections.how_to_use: Select candidate models, pick a main approach, justify metrics, and explain how results will be biologically meaningful.

sections.name: Ethical Considerations and Limitations
sections.purpose: Prompt responsible interpretation and transparent reporting.
sections.how_to_use: Select ethical issues, describe mitigation, and explain limitations that affect interpretation.

sections.name: Reflection
sections.purpose: Connect the design to iteration, collaboration, and communication.
sections.how_to_use: Describe how findings would shape future research and how to communicate to different audiences.

chatbot_guidance: When asked how to use this notebook, guide the learner through the five parts in order.
For basic science users, emphasize biological validity, batch effects, image quality, model interpretability, and reproducibility.
Help learners turn broad ideas into concrete SMART research questions.
